rationale: NBS DORA topic hub is the canonical SK supervisory landing page for ICT resilience deadlines; distinct enough from the NBS root to track on its own.
NBS Instant Payments/VoP hub carries the SK-facing IPR deadline schedule for PSPs — a recurring, dated obligation feed.
NBS AML/CFT legislation hub tracks SK landing of the EU AML package with effective dates; standalone monitorable page.
MF SR transposition register is the earliest official SK signal of coming implementing acts for financial-services directives.
Slov-Lex e-Zbierka search is the authoritative national legal gazette — durable, queryable backbone for SK effective dates.
ECB IPR policy page gives the authoritative euro-area timeline binding SK PSPs; stable, updated policy hub.
EPC VoP/SCT Inst rulebook and consultation page sets scheme-level implementation deadlines SK banks must meet.
Single Commission country page on NIS2 SK transposition; useful fact, but a section of the digital-strategy portal with little recurrence.
SBA site root is the only SK banking association; its news stream shows how EU deadlines are operationalised and contested.
Single PwC SK DORA explainer standing in for a bundle of advisory firms — secondary commentary, useful as evidence/lead-finding only.
One-off NBS PDF on EU payment-services law; authoritative terminology reference, not a recurring channel.
FSJ (SK FIU) root hub is the primary publisher of AML obligations, guidance and sanctions practice binding banks and PSPs.
Obligations-and-penalties page is a subsection of the FSJ hub already kept; high value but covered by the parent.
FSJ usmernenia PDF directory is a distinct recurring guidance repository; URL check failed, so liveness/listing access must be cleared first.
FIU annual report series is a recurring quantitative time series on AML supervisory pressure by sector.
Third-round national ML/TF risk assessment is a one-off report, but a strong predictor of supervisory intensity for banks and PSPs.
National AML/CFT strategy to 2030 is a single dated document with owners and deadlines — evidence for the SK regulatory roadmap.
Numbered FSJ briefing sheet in the kpo/u24 series; the series is reached via the FSJ hub/guidance repository already kept.
Consolidated AML Act page on Slov-Lex with amendment metadata gives exact effective dates — the SK deadline backbone.
Slov-Lex legislative-process tracker surfaces AML/payments drafts and PI notices before adoption — earliest deadline warning.
NR SR portal carries parliamentary prints and explanatory memoranda needed to date obligations before Zbierka publication.
NBS AML/CFT supervision hub hosts metodické usmernenia and risk-assessment output distinct from prudential pages; core monitorable section.
Direct download of a single Vestník guidance document; the Vestník index, not this file, is the monitorable channel.
NBS enforcement-decision register is a continuously updated view of actual AML fine severity against banks and PSPs.
MF SR sanctions hub is the competent-authority page for asset-freeze and reporting duties under zákon 289/2016.
MZV SR sanctions topic page publishes SK-language texts of new EU packages, often first nationally; standalone domain.
MONEYVAL hub publishes SK evaluation and follow-up reports that drive datable AML reform cycles.
FATF SK country page hosts ratings, FURs and any grey-list signal affecting SK-facing correspondent banking.
AMLA is the EU authority whose Level 2/3 measures and 2027/2028 milestones supersede much of the SK AML regime.
